baseBranch.description: Base branch for new branches. Omit to discover the remote default branch.

remote.description: Git remote. Omit to use origin, or the first available remote.

setup.description: Commands to run in separate interactive terminals, in parallel, after Worky creates a worktree. Omit for no setup.

cwd.description: Directory relative to the new worktree root. Use forward slashes; parent traversal and absolute paths are not allowed.

command.description: Bash command to run. The terminal stays interactive afterwards.

pullRequests.description: Pull request features for this checkout.

enabled.description: Disable to hide the PR view and sign-in action, cancel active requests, and stop PR loading.
